title: Signal Source v2 Artifact Metadata
description: Schema for _meta.json files written by v2 signal sources (TICKET_196_7_0 Q3, TICKET_196_7_0_1 Q2). Single source of truth shared by Python writers (nona_algorithm.signal_sources.*) and commercial C++ loaders (packages/research-kernels/src/signal/*_artifact_loader.cpp). TICKET_196_7_6_3 D3 extends the schema with a oneOf over signal_kind: factor artifacts use the factor_meta branch, existing kinds (HMM, n-gram, ML) keep their current shape under default_meta.

factor_meta.description: Factor signal artifact (TICKET_196_7_6_3 D2). signal_kind=factor is the discriminator. files MUST be empty: a factor is a stateless C++ formula with no on-disk fit state -- _meta.json is the entire artifact.

template_id.description: Registry key for the live loader (factor_<engine>_<factor_id>). TICKET_196_7_6_3 D1; TICKET_196_7_6_6 Slice S8 extended the prefix to cover alpha158 composites.

artifact_version.description: Template-author semver. Major-version mismatch is fatal at load.

fit_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp captured by the factor_eval plugin at result-write time.

fit_params.description: Verbatim params used at fit time. For factor artifacts this is the resolved factor.params (post cross-walk merge).

warmup_bars.description: max(lookback, indicator-specific warmup) per TICKET_196_7_6_3 D2.

files.description: Empty for factor artifacts -- no on-disk fit state.

signal_kind.description: Discriminator for the oneOf branch. TICKET_196_7_6_3 D2.

engine.description: Phase 1 (TICKET_196_7_6_2/3): talib. Phase 2 (TICKET_196_7_6_6 Slice S8): alpha158 composite factors. alpha101 reserved for later phases.

cpp_indicator_id.description: Phase 1 (talib): denormalized from talib_factors.json at save time; loader cross-checks against live cross-walk and fail-fasts on mismatch (TICKET_196_7_6_3 Open Q2). Phase 2 (alpha158, TICKET_196_7_6_6 Slice S8): the literal 'composite' sentinel -- a composite factor has no single cpp_indicator_id (descriptor lists N primitives); the loader uses factor_id for dispatch instead.

params.description: Runtime parameter binding for the indicator (post-Tool-Sweep resolved).

reducer.description: Reducer applied to per-bar indicator output (TICKET_196_7_6_2 Decision 1).

lookback.description: Window for the reducer. ZScore/Rank are degenerate when <= 1; the plugin fail-fasts in that case.

default_meta.description: Pre-existing artifact shape consumed by HMM / n-gram / ML loaders (TICKET_196_7_0_1 Q2, TICKET_196_7_3 Decision 5). signal_kind is OPTIONAL here; when present it must be one of the non-factor values. TICKET_196_7_6_3 D3 leaves these kinds free to add signal_kind at their next artifact version bump without coordinating here.

artifact_version.description: Template-author semver per TICKET_196_7_3 Decision 4. Major-version mismatch is fatal at load.

fit_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp captured by save_artifact().

fit_params.description: Verbatim PARAM_SCHEMA-validated params used at fit time. Shape is per-template; loaders pass this dict to the class constructor. C++ OnnxArtifactLoader reads: observable, lookback, z, window.

warmup_bars.description: First N predict outputs are NaN (TICKET_196_7_0 Q5). Equal to the instance's WARMUP_BARS class attr at save time.

files.description: Logical-name -> relative-filename map for all artifact data files in the same directory. The C++ loader reads only the files declared here.

signal_kind.description: Optional in this branch -- pre-existing fixtures predate this field. Excludes 'factor' because factor artifacts must match the factor_meta branch.

portable.description: TICKET_1292_21 Phase E portable fitted state consumed by the MC-17 C++ inference owner. Pickle files may coexist only as Python fit/reference artifacts.

ml.description: ML-specific sub-object per TICKET_196_7_3 Decision 5. Present only when the artifact was produced by an ML signal source (sklearn / xgboost / pytorch). HMM / n-gram artifacts omit this field entirely.

stack.description: Originating ML framework -- telemetry only; the model.onnx itself is stack-agnostic at the runtime layer.

onnx_opset_version.description: ONNX opset emitted by the export tool. C++ loader rejects if > runtime_max_supported_opset.

onnxruntime_min_version.description: Minimum onnxruntime version required at live runtime. Captured at fit time from the installed Python onnxruntime.

feature_dim.description: Number of features per input row. C++ loader validates session input shape [*, feature_dim] at construction; mismatch raises ArtifactShapeMismatch.

feature_mean.description: Optional per-feature mean used by an out-of-graph standardization step. Null when standardization is baked into the ONNX graph (sklearn StandardScaler in Pipeline, PyTorch buffer tensor) or absent (XGBoost). Escape-hatch field reserved for future stacks per Decision 5.

feature_std.description: Optional per-feature stdev paired with feature_mean. Same null-vs-array rules.

target_sigma.description: In-sample stdev of the regression target; sigma in tanh(z * raw / sigma) output mapping. C++ loader reads this and applies the same tanh post-processing -- the only non-ONNX math per Decision 5.

d_common.description: TICKET_1096 Phase 2: embedding output dimension. When present, the ONNX model has dual-head output (score + embedding[d_common]). Absent or 0 means scalar-only output (backward compatible).
